strengths: The steeper lower roof slopes, integrated-looking dormers, square lantern and taller spire substantially improve the recognizable University Hall silhouette over R4.
R5 adds restrained slate and brick variation, improved daylight shaping, and more convincing limestone hood details than the R4 applied semicircular trim.
The five recovered-column display elements correspond to Purdue's documented count and stated floor/stair locations; the report appropriately labels precise positions schematic.
The frozen candidate freshly reopens with identity root, 1,387 collection objects and 1,375 meshes, no materialless meshes, invalid slots, missing external images or linked libraries.
findings: The two-level gallery is visible in the cutaway, but the separate left stair assembly has a clear visual gap from the gallery rings. The view therefore does not establish a connected circulation route; the R5 handoff also explicitly notes this limitation.
The gallery rings and railing layout remain a simplified schematic and do not make the central opening's continuity and stair landing connections immediately legible.

The entrance still reads as a generic portico with broad pediment, plain cylindrical columns and generic doors. The new moulding improves relief but does not match the more articulated historic/current image context.

Most window openings remain a uniform repeated grid; the shallow segmental hoods are an improvement, but their identical profiles and strong bright contrast still look applied rather than deeply integrated.
The slate tile breakup is clearer than R4, although the long roof still reads as a regular, broad field of repeated units; brick, pale trim and glass retain a somewhat flat, schematic appearance.

The GIS comparison is against campus-map FID 213, not a surveyed wall outline. Prior full-ring comparison remains IoU 0.872874, symmetric mean boundary residual 0.916 m, 95th percentile 2.292 m, and maximum sampled residual 2.470 m. Master placement was not reviewed.

limitations: R5 does not reach the requested 8.0/10 threshold.
No measured elevations, roof plan or interior plan were found; heights, roof pitch, exact openings, gallery dimensions and display-column positions remain estimates or schematic.
A passing model grade would still require an independent master placement and neighborhood-alignment check by the coordinator.
